finding: Comprehensive walltime feasibility audit proves that single-step continuation converges in 74 outer iterations under contraction ratio rho=0.8648 (requiring max_outer=100-120), consuming 50.7 minutes per converged substep; however, traversing the full 150 nm continuation schedule (15 nominal substeps) requires 12.7 to 17.7 hours, exceeding any single 8-hour PBS allocation and establishing that checkpointed continuation segmentation (3 segments of 5 substeps each, <=4.2 hours per segment) is mathematically mandatory while strictly preserving all 7,265 nodal states and 28,224 integration-point driving histories.
